sections.title: I. Choose the correct word (A, B, C or D) to fill in each blank in the following passage. (1.0 point)
sections.introHtml:
THREE WAYS TO BECOME HEALTHIER

First of all, you need to eat the right kind of food. (1)_______ is unhealthy, so you shouldn’t eat it much. You shouldn’t eat too much fatty food, too. Things like chips and burgers have a lot of fat. You should also try to (2) _______ more fresh food and vegetables. Secondly, you should eat three meals a day so that you don’t get hungry. You definitely shouldn’t miss breakfast. When people don’t eat breakfast, they often eat (3) ________ snacks like chips during the day. Lastly, you don’t need to be good at sports, (4) _____ you should do some exercise. Exercise can be walking instead of taking the bus or using the stairs instead of the lift. You should do (5)_______ morning exercise. Only about twenty minutes for each and three times a week is fine.

sections.title: II. Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D). (1.0 point)
sections.introHtml:
Last summer, my class joined a volunteer program in a small village. We helped the villagers repair their houses, plant trees, and clean the environment. Every day we worked very hard, but we were happy because we helped people. The villagers were very kind and offered us local food. After a week, we felt tired but proud of our work.

This volunteer trip was a great experience for all of us. We learned how to work in a team and how to share with others. In the evenings, we played games and sang songs with the children in the village. They were friendly and always smiled. We also organized a small party on the last day to say goodbye. Everyone promised to come back next summer to help again. The trip taught us that helping others brings happiness to both people who give and those who receive.
